feedback_items.title: Clarify owner validation rule
feedback_items.description: Downstream decomposition could not tell whether temporary owners satisfy the approval rule.
downstream_evidence: Ownership check split into two incompatible task trees.
Implementation planning could not choose one validation rule.

proposed_changes.value: A system must have a permanent owner before approval.
proposed_changes.rationale: This removes the temporary-owner ambiguity discovered downstream.

feedback_items.requested_action: Clarify whether temporary ownership satisfies approval.
feedback_items.notes: Proposal only; do not patch the canonical model automatically.

feedback_items.title: Missing export audit requirement
feedback_items.description: Downstream implementation planning found no explicit requirement for export audit logging.
downstream_evidence: No requirement linked to the export audit tasks.

proposed_changes.value: Export actions must create an immutable audit log entry.
proposed_changes.rationale: Implementation scope already assumes this behavior.
